activity_summary: Richard came for the six pairs of sheep that you were to have walked back yourself after the frame. You could not go. He took them, and he will tell the man the writing was yours. You asked how to mend it if you could not be the legs, and you followed his answer: say carried, and stop. You did not go as far as the stair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked how to mend it, said carried, and did not follow him down.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the six pairs and refused the speech.

quotes.text: I'll say at his door that the writing was yours.

quotes.speaker: richard_shakespeare

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Carried. Thank you. Say it was my hand.
